moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-kanji-stroke-order, written here): Character in a 136 px box with a dashed centre cross over a grey underlay of all strokes (7 px, round caps). From 0.35 s each stroke draws along its centre-line in max(0.16 s, length × 3 ms/px), 100 ms gaps, fitted to 3.6 s, power1.inOut; the drawing stroke is accent with an arrowhead at its tip, finished strokes ink, a numbered badge at each stroke start. No stroke data: left → right sweep mask per glyph. Exit 4.55–4.85 s. Loop 5 s. Params: tốc độ (3 ms / px) · nghỉ giữa nét (100 ms) · độ dày nét (7 px). Each stroke takes max(0.16 s, its length × 3 ms per px of a 136 px box), power1.inOut; a numbered badge marks where each starts.
